title: Understanding the Parameter Vector
text: The parameter vector theta represents the coefficients in your linear regression model. Since you have $$9$$ features and an intercept, how many coefficients do you think you need?

title: Shape of the Design Matrix
text: Consider the design matrix X. It includes all your features plus an intercept. What would be the dimensions of X if you have $$400$$ flight records and $$9$$ features?

title: Dimensions of X
text: If X has $$400$$ rows (one for each flight record) and $$10$$ columns (9 features plus an intercept), what is the shape of X?

title: Relating X and Theta
text: The parameter vector theta is used to multiply with the design matrix X to predict the output. If X is 400x10, what should be the shape of theta to make this multiplication possible?

title: Shape of Theta
text: Given that X is 400x10, what is the shape of theta if it needs to multiply with X to produce a 400x1 output vector?
